_description: Canonical UniProt residue mapping for all data in organized_by_system_bundle_20260327. Protein offsets verified by exact sequence alignment of each construct (from rmsf.csv residue_name, ordered by residue_pdb) against canonical UniProt sequences (rest.uniprot.org, Sep 2026). The earlier uniprot_offset_map.json was computed against embedded sequences that turned out non-canonical for O95747 (1-aa insertion), Q96J92 (1-aa deletion) and Q9Y3S1 (different 841-aa sequence), producing offsets off by one (osr1, wnk4) or wrong (wnk2). Supersedes it.

osr1_cct.identity: res2-96 -> 433-527 (8/8 anchor check); pdb 1 is an N-terminal Gly expression-tag residue numbered by continuity (432)

wnk2_cctl1.identity: construct = UniProt 455-544 with internal deletion of UniProt 483-489 (KLKGKPK); 10/10 anchor check
wnk2_cctl1.note: changed vs original +455 (single offset was invalid: non-canonical source sequence)

osr1_cct.evidence: 2V3S chains C/D (author 1003-1008) -> WNK4 1015-1020 via PDBe SIFTS; GRFQVT unique at canonical Q96J92 1015-1020. Both copies map by position in the 6-mer: ordinal 1-6 -> 1015-1020 (copy D in the bundle has 5 res -> 1015-1019).

wnk2_cctl1.evidence: 6FBK chain P -> WNK1 1247-1269 via PDBe SIFTS (identity 1.0); canonical exact match 1247-1263 for the simulated 17-mer.

spak_cct.evidence: exact unique match at canonical Q96J92 1010-1024 (same WNK4 RFxV motif region as OSR1 ligand).

wnk4_cctl2.evidence: beta-phi-A motif (KKKSxFQITSV) of human TSC22D2: AF3 model WNK4(Q96J92)+TSC22D2(O75157-1), Magana-Avila et al. 2026 (DOI 10.64898/2026.04.15.718729). Exact unique match at canonical O75157 5-19; peptide file numbering 86-100 (ordinal 1-15) -> UniProt 5-19.

nrbp1_cct.evidence: RWTC (beta-phi-B) motif region of TSC22D2, shown to mediate binding to NRBP1 (Amnekar et al.; Magana-Avila et al. 2026, DOI 10.64898/2026.04.15.718729). Exact unique match at canonical O75157 173-187; peptide file numbering 1-15 (ordinal 1-15) -> UniProt 173-187.

ferry_cctl.evidence: same TSC22D2 RWTC-region peptide as nrbp1_cct; FERRY3 CCT-like interacts with TSC22D2 (Magana-Avila et al. 2026). Exact unique match at canonical O75157 173-187; peptide file numbering 78-92 (ordinal 1-15) -> UniProt 173-187.
